summary:
- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#94](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/94)** — A dedicated CUDA path was added to `ONNXInferenceModel`, binding ONNX outputs directly to CUDA device memory and ensuring the metric learning output tensor lives on the correct device for `buildEdgesFRNN`. Node feature inputs are now copied directly into an ACTS tensor on CUDA, skipping the intermediate torch tensor conversion, so ACTS' `OnnxEdgeClassifier` picks up the device correctly and the full GNN track-finding pipeline runs end-to-end on GPU.
- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#110](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/110)** — The `wget`-based retrieval of large tracking data files (geometry JSONs, material maps, ROOT files for MAIA, MuColl, MuSIC) was replaced with the CMake `ExternalData` mechanism, aligning the package with the Key4hep convention for distributing test/geometry data.
- **[key4hep/k4Reco#70](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Reco/pull/70)** — `TrackerHit3D` conversion was added to the KalTest machinery in `GaudiDDKalTestTrack`, restoring parity with the Marlin version and fixing an ILD reconstruction issue (`k4GaudiPandora#58`); a follow-up is still needed for FTD composite space points.
- **[key4hep/k4PFHitML#4](https://github.com/key4hep/k4PFHitML/pull/4)** — Events with no calorimeter hits or tracks are now skipped before invoking the clustering model, fixing a crash observed in the nightly CI for the ML-based particle flow component.
- **[key4hep/DDML#19](https://github.com/key4hep/DDML/pull/19)** — A new `ddml` Python module was added, providing `ddml_physics` and `add_shower_model` helpers plus pre-configured model configurations, replacing the organically-grown `ddsim_steer.py` flag/if-else chains with a `ModelConfig`-based setup that unifies ONNX and Torch inference configuration for fast-sim shower models.
- **[key4hep/DDML#34](https://github.com/key4hep/DDML/pull/34)** — The BIBAE Two Angle fast-sim shower model was added to the set of models retrievable via `ExternalData`, making it available alongside the existing CaloClouds models.
- **[key4hep/DDML#16](https://github.com/key4hep/DDML/pull/16)** — The ML inference model is now initialized before the event loop instead of lazily inside `runInference`, geometry initialization was deferred until DD4hep settings are available, the concept interfaces were completed, and the default was changed to non-hadron showers.
- **[key4hep/DDML#20](https://github.com/key4hep/DDML/pull/20)** — The ONNX and Torch inference backends were fixed to only copy the number of elements actually returned by the model rather than the maximum output buffer size, eliminating reads of garbage past the real output data (previously benign but potentially crash-prone).
- **[key4hep/DDML#17](https://github.com/key4hep/DDML/pull/17)** — A first runtime test setup was added that exercises CaloClouds3 end-to-end and verifies the resulting output files contain MCParticles handled by fast simulation; a reference-counting issue uncovered by this test was worked around by leaking a resource pending a proper fix.
- **[hep-fcc/FCCAnalyses#561](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses/pull/561)** — Condor log/output handling in `run_analysis.py` and `run_fccanalysis.py` was adjusted so that HTCondor warnings on log file placement no longer trigger up to ten spurious retry submissions on the pre-EDM4hep1 stack.
- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#101](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/101)** — The GENFIT track fitter was fixed with the correct units in the helix-to-Cartesian Jacobian and `z0` conversion, a singular initial covariance when the seed is near the reference point was prevented, and track-state construction now uses GENFIT native extrapolation to the point of closest approach with the first and last digitized hits as references for `AtFirstHit`/`AtLastHit`. The documented limitation that `AtIP` is not meaningful for displaced tracks was also added.
- **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes#162](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/162)** — The Delphes to EDM4hep converter now assumes the pion mass for all tracks other than electrons and muons to keep energy, mass and momentum consistent, and assigns PDG IDs to tracks and leptons so analysts no longer have to recover particle identity from mass values. Jet energy/mass consistency with constituents is now also checked in the tests.
- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#433](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/433)** — Boolean Gaudi properties can again be switched off from the `k4run` command line: a dedicated parser accepting `True/False`, `true/false`, `1/0` was added, and a bare flag now sets the property to `True` instead of `None` (which Gaudi silently converted to `False`). Previously, `--Alg.Prop=False` was always truthy because `bool("False")` is `True`.
- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#437](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/437)** — The k4FWCore Python package is now installed into `${GAUDI_INSTALL_PYTHONDIR}` rather than a hardcoded `python/` directory, aligning with Gaudi v41r0's new layout (`lib/pythonX.Y/site-packages`) so that `k4FWCorePluginsConf.py` and the Python sources end up in the same directory; without this the IOSvc-based pipelines were broken.
- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#436](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/436)** — Gaudi v41r1 is now required for the EventContext-based data handle API, following up on #432 since the needed changes did not make it into the 41.0 release.
- **[key4hep/key4hep-spack#930](https://github.com/key4hep/key4hep-spack/pull/930)** — The `k4_local_repo` nightly and release setup scripts were updated for the Gaudi 41 install layout: `GAUDI_PLUGIN_PATH` now includes `install/lib{,64}/gaudi-plugins` and `PYTHONPATH` is extended with `install/lib{,64}/python<version>/site-packages` so locally built Gaudi plugins and Python modules are picked up correctly.
- **[key4hep/key4hep-spack#929](https://github.com/key4hep/key4hep-spack/pull/929)** — A `tracking` variant was added to the `k4rectracker` Spack recipe that steers the new `K4RECTRACKER_TRACKING` CMake flag, and the base spec was renamed to `main`, enabling muon-collider stacks to build the package without Marlin/LCIO.
- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#97](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/97)** — A new `K4RECTRACKER_TRACKING` CMake flag (default ON) was added to gate compilation of the FCCee tracking components, so the package can now be built in software stacks that do not ship Marlin/LCIO (e.g. the muon collider stack) while retaining the digitisers.
- **[key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper#489](https://github.com/key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper/pull/489)** — The deprecated `inputReader` Python module was removed; it relied on `PodioInput`, which has been dropped from k4FWCore, so users must now switch to `k4MarlinWrapper.io_helpers`.
- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config#383](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/383)** — The IDEA option 2 full-simulation reconstruction configuration and a corresponding CTest based on the reduced geometry were added, catching up with features previously only available for IDEA option 1 (tracking, track validation, planar digitiser inputs) and depending on `k4RecCalorimeter#271`.
- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config#400](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/400)** — A new EvtGen decay card `Lb2L1520NuNu.dec` was added for Λ_b⁰ → Λ(1520)⁰ ν ν̄ with Λ(1520)⁰ → p⁺ K⁻ and the charge-conjugate chain, tested with the winter2023 Key4hep stack.
- **[key4hep/k4geo#665](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/665)** — The IDEA `SteeringFile_IDEA_o1_v03.py` was updated to set the shared-events flag to `false` when running single-threaded, following up on the related DD4hep fix (`AIDASoft/DD4hep#1678`); backwards compatibility was ensured in response to release-build issues with `numberOfThreads`.
- **[hep-fcc/root2gltf#17](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/root2gltf/pull/17)** — Options were added to assign a random color to volumes whose color is undefined, black or white and to apply decreasing opacity from inner to outer layers, with the example configuration files for ALLEGRO, CLD, IDEA and ILD updated accordingly.
- **[hep-fcc/phoenix-at-fcc#28](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/phoenix-at-fcc/pull/28)** — Updated detector geometries (with generated colors and transparency for previously gray volumes) were linked into the Phoenix event display, a dedicated ILD_FCCee component with logo was added, and `ALLEGRO_o2_v01`, `IDEA_o1_v04`, `IDEA_o2_v01` and `CLD_o2_v08` were added while the older `CLD_o2_v07` was replaced.
